scopeLabel: dynabook Japan manufacturer PDF manual index: PC products announced 2024, 2025 and 2026 (consumer, business and ChromeOS)

universe.populationMethod: complete nested official product row extraction from 3 annual manufacturer manual download indexes; 178 source rows grouped to 177 unique canonical model and explicitly separated configuration identities
universe.notes: 47 manufacturer rows in 2024 +32 in 2025 +99 in 2026 =178 source rows. Two 2026 dynabook B86/PA announcements (2026-01-22 and 2026-09-08) explicitly link the same manuals and are tracked as two source rows of one unique canonical model, not two distinct product models. XP7/AR P2P7ARBL/P1P7ARBL remain separate because the official model cell explicitly includes distinct part codes. GR/ZA Home vs Pro remain distinct configuration models. Source row digest and exact order must reconcile before accepting candidates. 2026-10-31 live GitHub Actions review: 53 distinct official PDF destinations verified by HTTPS redirect, status and %PDF- signature. Final 177 = 16 direct + 161 manufacturer-explicit shared + 0 support_only + 0 held. Official 2024,2025,2026 source-row SHA256 and expected row counts independently rechecked in live CI; duplicate B86/PA rows have the same manual URL vector and are one canonical identity.

candidateRun.duplicateSourceException: dynabook B86/PA repeated 2026 Jan/Sep, identical official document URLs, canonicalized once

review.notes: All 177 were positively mapped by the manufacturer's own product row to a dynabook-controlled HTTPS PDF, and all 53 distinct destination URLs returned valid PDF signatures. No missing rows, weak held or unverified mirrors. Same actual manufacturer-issued PDF is explicitly linked from each shared model's row.
